title: Satwik-Chirag Win 10th BWF World Tour Title at China Masters
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair secured their 10th BWF World Tour title, boosting confidence for upcoming major events.
summary: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty defeated China’s He Jiting and Ren Xiangyu in a thrilling three-game final to clinch the China Masters 2026, marking a significant milestone in their career.

title: Satwik-Chirag Discuss China Masters Strategy, Eye Asian Games Defence
indian_angle: The Indian champions shared insights into their successful strategy at the China Masters and their focus on defending their Asian Games title.
summary: Following their China Masters triumph, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty revealed their 'Plan A' strategy of strong defence and patient attack, expressing confidence for their upcoming Asian Games title defence.

title: BAI Announces Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course signifies BAI's commitment to developing coaching talent within India, crucial for nurturing future badminton stars.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is organizing a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14-23, 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: India's young talent is undergoing intensive training at NCE Guwahati to prepare for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system aims to enhance the competitive experience and strategic development for India's young badminton players in domestic events.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
